item.description:
I love how many organic GTAVI threads we have.
>"Hey! M-My thread is there and I'm not part of some advertising company!!!"
You are doing it for free then.
Actually no, you paid money to watch an ad so you actually paid to advertise a game.

Would be cool if mods required one-two threads at a time like with many other games. Despite anons complaining about shit like Umamusume and Deltarune, you didn't see tens of threads at the sam
